data.body: **[P2] Preserve ended parents when the completion actually preceded them.** `endedOperationIds` reflects hook order, not durable timestamp order. If an unawaited callback completes while its child context is still running, the update is queued, the context then ends, and this check incorrectly reparents the callback to `Workflow` despite its valid `parentId` and earlier `EndTimestamp`. Drain pending children before ending their parent, or retain parent end times and detach only when the child truly ends later; add a callback-before-context-end test.
